message: Here are 8 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Unguarded floor opening
hazards.description: A large rectangular floor opening in the foreground, exposing the cable vault below, has no cover, guardrail or barricade, creating a fall hazard for workers using the aisle.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Work inside open energized switchgear
hazards.description: A worker in the center is reaching into an open switchgear section with exposed breakers and terminals, and no barriers or isolation devices are visible.

hazards.title: Multiple switchgear sections left open
hazards.description: Several switchgear sections along the right-side lineup are open, exposing internal electrical components to workers passing nearby.

hazards.title: Worker reaching overhead on stepladder
hazards.description: A worker at the upper left stands on the upper steps of an orange stepladder, reaching overhead into the cable tray with the body extended upward.

hazards.title: Extension cord across walkway
hazards.description: An orange extension cord runs loosely across the main floor aisle from the ladder area toward the right, creating a trip hazard.

hazards.title: Materials stored near opening edge
hazards.description: Metal cable tray sections are stacked on the floor at the left near the edge of the unprotected floor opening, where they could be knocked into the vault.

hazards.title: Cluttered aisle along switchgear
hazards.description: Boxes, a cable reel, metal channel pieces, a tool case and carts crowd the floor along the switchgear lineup, narrowing the space in front of the electrical equipment.

hazards.title: Strut channel leaning against equipment
hazards.description: Lengths of metal strut channel lean upright against the switchgear on the right and could topple onto workers.
